scientific_integrity: The all-rank recurrence, outer-shell counts and CLT are supported by an explicit matching-state transfer proof and analytic spectral argument. Exact finite computations corroborate the proof rather than establish it.
scientific_limitations: Standard, unscaled type-A shard realization for alternating singleton arc runs only. Pair statistics are for vertices, not continuous volume sampling. The previously published all-shard diameter theorem already covers the diameter value. Historical priority is provisional; independent audit is not performed.
title: Exact Euclidean chord spectra and Gaussian fluctuations of alternating shard polytopes
